description: Sales engagement: prospects, sequences and tasks.

validation.method: static — shapes derived from the official OpenAPI spec (https://api.outreach.io/api/v2/schema/openapi.json) + Pipedream actions; filters/pagination cross-checked against the spec's per-relationship filter notes and Airbyte source-outreach's live incremental-sync params; smoke test blocked: Outreach has no self-serve signup (demo-request only) and the developer portal requires an existing org admin account. Production-connector cross-validation pass (2026-06): checked ActivePieces (no outreach piece), n8n (no Outreach node), Microsoft PowerPlatformConnectors (no Outreach connector); corroborated against estuary/connectors source-outreach (newFilterSyntax [gte]/[lte] datetime cursors, page[size]/page[after] from links.next), singer-io/tap-outreach a.k.a. Stitch (old-syntax filter[updatedAt]=<full ISO datetime>..inf + sort + count=false, links.next pagination), Supaglue (supaglue-labs, via fork: old-syntax ..inf with millisecond ISO datetimes; JSON:API create bodies for account/prospect/sequenceState incl. emails[] attribute and prospect/sequence/mailbox relationships), and friggframework api-module-library (task create/update with polymorphic subject relationship, live-test fixture). No contradictions found; no script changes required.

sources.prospects: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec + Pipedream create-prospect action; create body (attributes incl. emails[], account relationship) corroborated by Supaglue's production mapper; list filters corroborated by the Stitch tap; not run live
sources.accounts: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec + Pipedream create-account action; create body (name/domain attributes, owner relationship) corroborated by Supaglue; list filters corroborated by the Stitch tap; not run live
sources.sequences: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec; reads corroborated by Supaglue (sequences/sequenceSteps) and the Stitch tap; not run live
sources.sequence_states: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec + Pipedream add-prospect-sequence action; create body (prospect/sequence/mailbox relationships, mailbox required) matches Supaglue's production mapper exactly; not run live
sources.mailings: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec; list + updatedAt filter corroborated by the Stitch tap and Estuary; not run live
sources.tasks: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec; polymorphic subject relationship on create/update corroborated by friggframework's live-test fixture; list filters corroborated by the Stitch tap; not run live
sources.mailboxes: MEDIUM — official OpenAPI spec + Pipedream mailbox options resolver; list corroborated by the Stitch tap; not run live

response_fields.next: links.next (full URL; the page[after] value is its query param)

gotchas: JSON:API — every request with a body must send Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json or the API returns 415.
Write payloads wrap fields as { data: { type, attributes, relationships } }; ids are integers.

Filters: filter[attr]=value; multi filter[id]=1,2,3; ranges filter[updatedAt]=2024-01-01..inf (full ISO datetimes work too — Stitch's tap and Supaglue both send filter[updatedAt]=<datetime>..inf in production; range bounds are inclusive); relationship filters filter[prospect][id]=123 (only [id] is reliably supported — attribute-based relationship filters were deprecated May 2023); sort=-createdAt for descending.

New filter syntax (newFilterSyntax=true) replaces ranges with filter[attr][gte]/[lte] and value lists with filter[attr][]=v — required when values contain ',' or '..'; Airbyte's connector uses it for datetime cursors, so prefer it for timestamp comparisons.
Task↔prospect association is set via the polymorphic `subject` relationship (type account|opportunity|prospect); the `prospect` relationship on tasks is readonly/derived.
Action endpoints (POST …/tasks/{id}/actions/markComplete, …/sequenceStates/{id}/actions/{pause|resume|finish}) take no request body and return 200 with the updated resource.
OAuth access tokens last 2h; refresh is grant_type=refresh_token at the same https://api.outreach.io/oauth/token endpoint, so Windmill auto-refresh works.

Scopes are <pluralResource>.<read|write|delete|all>, e.g. prospects.all sequenceStates.all. All scopes registered in oauth_connect.json are enumerated verbatim in Outreach's official SDK (getoutreach/extensibility-sdk, src/manifest/api/Scopes.ts).

errors.415: Missing/wrong Content-Type — JSON:API requires application/vnd.api+json on requests with a body.
errors.502: Bad Gateway on list endpoints usually means the requested page[size] was too large to serve in time — retry with a smaller page[size] (Estuary's connector halves it and retries).
errors.422: Validation error — response carries errors[] with title/detail and a source.pointer to the offending attribute.

resource_type.name: outreach
resource_type.description: OAuth2 access token for the Outreach REST API (api.outreach.io). Connect with OAuth so the token refreshes automatically — Outreach has no long-lived API keys.

token.description: OAuth2 access token, filled automatically when you connect with OAuth (recommended — tokens are refreshed for you). Pasting a token minted from your own Outreach OAuth app (https://developers.outreach.io/api/oauth/) also works but it expires after 2 hours, so only do that for one-off testing.
